# 06 - project and global instructions both attach

Contract: `UPSTREAM-CONTRACT.md` Sec.4.3 - the global and project levels are
found independently ("both can attach"), and precedence places the global
file first.

The global `AGENTS.md` wins over `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` within the global
level. The project walk-up attaches `worktree/AGENTS.md` as the second
instruction.
